name: Getting Things Done (GTD): The Overview
instructions: The core GTD idea: capture every task and idea out of your head and into a trusted system, so your brain stops trying to remember them.
Process your capture list regularly: decide what each item actually requires, and either do it, schedule it, delegate it, or drop it.
Organize actionable items into clear next-action lists by context, so you always know what to do next in any given situation.
Watch today's video for the full GTD methodology overview.
